title: Real Estate Service Contracts: Number of Contracts per Customer
content:
There is no limit on how many Real Estate Service Contracts one customer may be associated with. A homeowner may be the seller on one transaction and the buyer on another, and an agent may order plans for any number of clients. The maximum number of contracts per customer is therefore not set: no figure applies.

How many open orders one property may carry is a separate matter, governed by the rule that one property transaction carries one real estate plan.

## Basis Q&A

**May a customer who is selling one home under a listing order also be the buyer on another home's plan?** Yes. The same customer may be the seller on one transaction and the buyer on another.

**Is there a ceiling on the number of clients for whom one agent orders plans?** No. An agent may order plans for any number of clients.
